scope: follow-up correction families; earlier round1 test outcomes already exist
primary_plan: core GFNet/AFNO contrasts at seeds42–46 (10); matched dense seeds42–44 (3); five pretrained backbones seed42 (5)
factorial_plan: four simple and three joint effects per seed42–44 (21), plus three across-seed crossed-bootstrap joint effects
tuned_plan: selected PSAN versus each of seven selected baseline arms, seed42
correction: Bonferroni, including planned comparisons if any are not completed
p_definition: smoothed two-sided bootstrap tail probability; approximate, not exact randomization

patient_dependence: unknown dog dependence is not covered
